## Execution boundary

User: “make test-sandbox is yours, Docker groups and any TLA+ come to me via a scheduler handoff, TLA+ only if spec/tla changes.”

Execute repository tests, scripts and binaries only through `make sandbox` or `make test-sandbox`, with fresh isolated HOME, AD store, socket and owned processes. Existing Cursor login stays as is; separately authorized live work runs isolated under `~/ad-codex/ftd/` and stops if login is unreachable. No host tests/binaries, local Docker TESTPLAN groups/collectors, TLC, parsers, scheduler submissions or pushes. Only actual changed `spec/tla/**` model inputs warrant affected-model scheduler jobs, with reasons; do not manufacture model changes or baseline jobs. AD never derives state, identity, permissions or liveness from screen text. Local commits are coordinator-owned on feature/b.ftd with scope b.jf1. Technical decisions are recorded in the SRD; escalate only genuine product questions.
